{{Top|canon=Prefabricated shelter}}
[[File:Building.jpg|thumb|Prefab shelters used by the Confederacy of Independent Systems]]
'''Prefab shelters''' were structures constructed with [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] used by many civilizations to support their people, and were constructed by [[Droid/Legends|droid]] or organic workers such as [[Glurrg]]s. Although the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] was more than capable of building and using prefab centers, they did not use prefab shelters a large percentage of the time because of their extensive use of droids. The [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] indigenous [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], built prefab shelters underwater. The [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] prefab shelters allowed for a significant increase in its numbers compared to the prefab shelters of other factions.

==Behind the scenes==
Prefab shelters appear in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' and its [[2003]] [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|expansion pack]]. The Trade Federation, unlike the other civilizations, was not required to build the structures to support their army, but Federation shelters did appear in the game.
